digest.overview: Short overnight window highlights OpenAI's technical reveal on its rebuilt realtime voice stack for natural, full-duplex conversations at scale. Enterprise pushback from Palantir's Karp and a major Ukraine drone AI deal add tension around deployment and geopolitics. Open model chatter and funding notes fill the rest.

top_story.headline: OpenAI details GPT-Live realtime voice architecture rebuild
top_story.summary: @OpenAI and @gdb posted on the new full-duplex stack enabling continuous audio flow, deeper reasoning/tool use without interruptions, built in six months for ChatGPT-scale deployment.
top_story.why_it_matters: Moves voice AI from turn-based to natural back-and-forth at production scale; Reddit threads surfaced the posts within hours.

sentiment.label: optimistic
sentiment.summary: Excitement around OpenAI's voice progress and open ecosystem tools; mixed notes on adoption challenges for new Chinese models and enterprise trust issues.

frontier_labs.headline: Palantir CEO Alex Karp calls AI industry 'Marxist' after $1B profit quarter
frontier_labs.summary: Karp warns frontier labs are untrustworthy for enterprises post-strong earnings.

frontier_labs.headline: Baseten raises $13B Series F as inference engineering leader
frontier_labs.summary: Focus on autoregressive and diffusion infra; positions as key player in production serving.

research_radar.headline: LLMs reward expertise
research_radar.summary: Essay argues LLMs amplify skilled users' advantages in prompting and verification rather than leveling the field.
